crop.rationale: This is the smallest coherent crop that still visibly shows both supported inputs: the transcriptome-derived embedding and the prepared natural-language question, along with the arrows and the immediate adapter/LLM entry point. It excludes the downstream prediction, perplexity scoring, and right-side performance panels.
